id: \bThere's rumors a spirit from the tower got out. I can't have you disturbing it.
en: \bThere's rumors a spirit from the tower got out. I can't have you disturbing it.
it: \bGira voce che uno spirito sia fuggito dalla torre. Non posso permetterti di disturbarlo.

id: \rThat white hand on your shoulder...\nI'm just imagining it.
en: \rThat white hand on your shoulder...\nI'm just imagining it.
it: \rQuella mano bianca sulla tua spalla...\nMe la sto solo immaginando.

id: \bThis town is known as the grave site of Pokémon.
en: \bThis town is known as the grave site of Pokémon.
it: \bQuesta città è nota come il cimitero dei Pokémon.

id: \bMemorial services are held in Pokémon Tower.
en: \bMemorial services are held in Pokémon Tower.
it: \bNella Torre Pokémon si celebrano le funzioni commemorative.
\bNella Torre Pokémon sono comparsi dei fantasmi.

id: \rDon't go in there. Scary Pokémon might attack you.
en: \rDon't go in there. Scary Pokémon might attack you.
it: \rNon entrare lì. Potresti essere attaccato da Pokémon spaventosi.

id: Pokémon Tower\nBecalm the Spirits of Pokémon
en: Pokémon Tower\nBecalm the Spirits of Pokémon
